title: Intel added $100B+ in value and now has a $300B+ market cap after its stock jumped 53% in nine sessions on plans to buy an Ireland fab and join Terafab (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Intel added $100B+ in value and now has a $300B+ market cap after its stock jumped 53% in nine sessions on plans to buy an Ireland fab and join Terafab — Intel Corp. has quickly become one of the hottest stocks in the S&P 500 Index thanks to a nine-day surge that has added more than $100 billion in market value.
